trends.name: Chocolate brown
trends.definition: Brown as the new neutral — cocoa, espresso, golden brown.
trends.reasoning: WGSN × Coloro put Cocoa Powder in the AW26/27 palette, retailers name chocolate brown the colour of fall 2026 footwear, and Pantone lists a dark golden brown as a year-round neutral for SS27. That's a plateau, not a spike.
trends.wouldChange: Saturated colour pushing brown out of the SS27 retail palette.

signals.summary: Chocolate brown named the colour choice of fall 2026 in footwear; a broader range of browns feels fresh.
Arrowwood, a dark golden brown, named one of five year-round neutrals for SS27.
Cocoa Powder, a rich chocolate brown, among WGSN × Coloro's five AW26/27 key colours.

trends.name: Suede
trends.definition: Suede jackets, bags and loafers in warm, deep tones.
trends.reasoning: Suede is at its peak. Heuritech forecasts it up 45% this season, and WWD's retail survey calls brown suede 'the choice of the season' in fall 2026 footwear. After more than two years of growth, the open question is when it slows, not whether it's mainstream.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech's 12-month forecast turning negative.

signals.summary: Retailers: brown suede is the choice of the season for fall 2026; lug styles in black and brown suede.
Suede estimated to grow 45% this season.

trends.name: Boho, brightened
trends.definition: Bohemian dressing, now sunnier: paisley, floaty shapes, sugary shades.
trends.reasoning: Search interest in 'boho chic' is up 30% year on year worldwide (Google Trends, reported by Heuritech), and WWD's denim coverage names boho a defining direction for 2026. Measured demand and the trade press both say it's mainstream now.
trends.wouldChange: Year-on-year search growth turning negative.

signals.summary: 'Boho chic' searches +30% year on year worldwide; boho 're-established as one of the defining aesthetics of 2026'.
Boho named among the defining directions for denim in 2026, alongside 80s and indie sleaze.

trends.name: The loafer
trends.definition: Loafers — suede, polished, PVC — as the everyday shoe.
trends.reasoning: Saint Laurent and The Row loafers were the second and fourth hottest products on the Lyst Index, footwear retailers expect loafers to carry into fall 2026, and Heuritech still forecasts suede loafers up 7% over 12 months. Slow, steady growth like this points to a new classic.
trends.wouldChange: No loafer in the Lyst top-10 products for two quarters running.

signals.summary: Loafers expected to continue into fall 2026: suede, exotics, tasselled and spectators.
Suede loafers forecast +7% worldwide over the next 12 months.
Saint Laurent and The Row loafers ranked #2 and #4 hottest products.

trends.name: Animal print
trends.definition: Leopard, zebra, snake and cow print.
trends.reasoning: The sources disagree here, and that's the story. Heuritech's consumer-image data has it turning down (leopard −10% in dresses, cow −29%), while Roberto Cavalli's SS27 runway went all in on leopard and zebra and fall footwear is full of animal print. The wide band reflects that disagreement.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech's SS27 update turning positive would settle it upward.

signals.summary: Roberto Cavalli spring 2027: leopard spots and zebra stripes on sheer tops, robes and shirts.
Fall 2026 footwear: lots of suede, velvet and animal print across collections.
Leopard forecast −10% in dresses, −6% in skirts; zebra and snake −4%; cow −29%. Only croc (+9%) and tiger (+6%) grow.

trends.name: East-west bags
trends.definition: Long, horizontal bags — from slim baguettes to bowling bags.
trends.reasoning: Who What Wear's reporting has east-west as the year's defining bag shape, reworked by Chanel, Celine, Coach and Khaite. Only one source group supports it after the source clean-up, so the band is wide.
trends.wouldChange: An east-west bag missing from the Lyst hottest products for two quarters.

signals.summary: East-west the year's trademark shape; Chanel, Celine, Coach, Khaite reworking it.

trends.name: Barrel-leg denim
trends.definition: Curved, hip-to-ankle barrel jeans.
trends.reasoning: Barrel jeans have been mainstream for over a year, and denim buyers say they're holding up. But the same WWD Sourcing Journal reporting flags slimmer legs and lower rises starting to take over. It's at its peak, with a successor already visible.
trends.wouldChange: Search interest falling below its 2025 average.

signals.summary: Trend analysis of barrel-leg trousers as an established 2026 silhouette.
Barrel jeans stay strong while slimmer fits and lower rises start to rise; super-wide shapes are simmering down.

trends.name: Slim, low-profile sneakers
trends.definition: Flat soles and close-to-foot uppers: Taekwondo, Speedcat, retro runners.
trends.reasoning: Lyst's shopper data has put Nike styles, including the Jacquemus collaboration, among the hottest products. But StockX shows performance-lifestyle runners growing fastest now, and that's the likely successor. This is mainstream today with a shorter shelf life.
trends.wouldChange: A chunky or tech-runner silhouette taking the top sneaker slot in the Lyst Index.

signals.summary: Two Nike sneakers, one a Jacquemus collaboration, in the Lyst Index top-10 products.

trends.name: Lingerie as daywear
trends.definition: Visible bras, slips, plunging necklines and soft corsetry worn in daylight.
trends.reasoning: This is the most consistent SS27 story across cities and source types: Milan retailers flagged bra tops, slips and boudoir dressing, New York showed déshabillé and romantic corsets, and Heuritech's shopper-image data independently forecasts deep-plunge tops up 47%. Buyers, editors and consumer data all point the same way.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech revising plunge-top growth down, or buyers cutting it from spring orders.

signals.summary: Milan retailers flag sheerness, lingerie and boudoir dressing: bra tops, slips, robes; bras worn as tops.
The visible bra, worn with a skirt, called the defining look of spring 2027.
Déshabillé at Altuzarra, Christian Cowan and Zoe Gustavia Anna Whalen: exposed undergarments, straps off the shoulder.
Corsets trending for spring 2027 — romantic, not lingerie-esque — at Altuzarra and Khaite.
Forecasts deep-plunge tops +47% visibility within its FW26 'sportsmart' and romance directions.

trends.name: Open-toe sandals, everywhere
trends.definition: Thongs, slides, T-straps, huaraches and gladiators become the default summer shoe — for men too.
trends.reasoning: Shopper data and buyers point the same way. Lyst's Q2 data had open-toe and vacation shoes in four of the ten hottest-product slots with triple-digit growth, and in Milan and Paris menswear, buyers named fisherman sandals the must-have for spring 2027. When demand comes first and buyers are already ordering, the trend usually returns strongly in spring.
trends.wouldChange: Weak sandal demand in Lyst's Q1 2027 data, or high-street spring ranges that lead with sneakers instead.

signals.summary: Four of Q2 2026's ten hottest products were open-toe or vacation shoes (Skims jelly shoes, Gucci Vittoria, Chloé jelly mules, Massimo Dutti toe sandals), all with triple-digit demand growth.
Paris men's shoe moments for spring 2027 led by naked sandals alongside boots and slender lace-ups.
Milan menswear buyers: no man can be without fisherman sandals for spring 2027; leather sandals now part of the core wardrobe system.

trends.name: Lace, everywhere
trends.definition: Directional lace — on bombers, tops and menswear, not just lingerie.
trends.reasoning: This is one of the best-supported calls in the edition: Pinterest Predicts named 'Laced Up' a 2026 trend, Heuritech forecasts fine lace up 42% and lace-detail tops up 107%, Milan's SS27 leaned on lace transparencies, and it has reached menswear through Simone Rocha. Search data, image data and runway all agree.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech's lace growth slowing below 10%.

signals.summary: Transparencies in organza, lace and chiffon made Milan's spring 2027 soft and feminine.
Simone Rocha's menswear debut built on lacework and broderie anglaise.
'Laced Up' named a 2026 trend: directional lace on everything from bombers to beauty.
Fine lace forecast +42% visibility; lace-detail tops +107%.

trends.name: Glamoratti maximalism
trends.definition: Dialled-up opulence: sculpted shoulders, funnel necks, colour-blocking.
trends.reasoning: Several sources describe the same move away from minimalism, from next season through 2028. Pinterest's 'Glamoratti' prediction, Who What Wear's AW26 framing and Copenhagen's SS27 data ('colour is back, neutrals are out') cover the near term. Longer out, Euromonitor's 'Fiercely Unfiltered' consumer research and WGSN's 2028 'Challengers' persona describe the same appetite for bold self-expression.
trends.wouldChange: Minimal, neutral collections winning Paris SS27 reviews.

signals.summary: AW26 is 'a lesson in maximalism': colour-blocking, texturemaxxing, prints galore.
Copenhagen SS27 data: 'colour is back, neutrals are out'.
WGSN 2028 'Challengers', the most visible fashion persona, thrive on expression and provocation.
'Glamoratti': a return to opulence — sculpted shoulders 'three sizes' bigger, funnel necks.
'Fiercely Unfiltered': half of consumers seek products that reflect their unique identity; bold self-expression over conformity.

trends.name: Performance-lifestyle runners
trends.definition: Technical running shoes (Mizuno, Saucony, Salomon, New Balance) worn as everyday sneakers.
trends.reasoning: StockX's resale data shows Mizuno as the fastest-growing sneaker brand (+124%), followed by Saucony and Salomon, all performance-lifestyle silhouettes, and Lyst's Q2 index was driven by sport, including Miu Miu × New Balance. Measured demand is moving from slim retro sneakers toward technical runners.
trends.wouldChange: The StockX mid-year report showing the growth reversing.

signals.summary: Q2 2026 index 'all about desire, sport and summer'; Miu Miu × New Balance drove a 30% search lift.
Mizuno the fastest-growing sneaker brand (+124%), with Saucony (+59%) and Salomon (+58%): performance-lifestyle silhouettes.

trends.name: Sportsmart
trends.definition: Technical sportswear meets romantic shapes: ringer tees, blouson windbreakers, sneaker collabs.
trends.reasoning: Heuritech names 'sportsmart' a key FW26 direction, forecasting ringer tees up 38% and blouson windbreakers up 10%. Lyst's Q2 index was 'all about desire, sport and summer', with Miu Miu × New Balance pushing demand.
trends.wouldChange: Sport collaborations dropping out of the Lyst Q3 product ranking.

signals.summary: Q2 2026 index 'all about desire, sport and summer'; Miu Miu × New Balance lifted searches 30%.
'Sportsmart' — technical performancewear fused with romantic shapes; ringer tees +38%, blouson windbreakers +10%.

trends.name: Texturemaxxing
trends.definition: Feathers, beads, sequins, chainmail and fur trims — embellishment as everyday.
trends.reasoning: This season is in stores now. Who What Wear's AW26 round-up leads with heavy embellishment, and Heuritech's image data forecasts fur details up 14% and feathers up 12%, in line with a wider 'fun again' move away from minimalism.
trends.wouldChange: Weak AW26 sell-through reported in Q4 trading updates.

signals.summary: AW26 led by heavy embellishment — feathers, beads, sequins, chainmail — and 'texturemaxxing'.
Forecasts fur details +14% and feathers +12%; 'strong appetite for texture, embellishment and emotional dressing'.

trends.name: Cherry to oxblood
trends.definition: Deep reds and red-purples, from cherry to oxblood.
trends.reasoning: Heuritech's FW26 data leans on 'rich red-purple hues', and Pantone's NYFW SS27 palette carries a 'dark, heated red' into next spring. It has the rare backing to span two seasons.
trends.wouldChange: Red falling out of the Paris SS27 colour counts.

signals.summary: A dark, heated red in the NYFW SS27 top-10.
FW26 'opulent romance' carried by rich red-purple hues.

trends.name: The brooch revival
trends.definition: Brooches on lapels, in hair, clustered on necklines — for men too.
trends.reasoning: Pinterest's search data flagged men driving a brooch revival, and brooches stood out in Copenhagen's SS27 street style. That's measured search behaviour plus street confirmation, at a low price point: a likely small call.
trends.wouldChange: High-street jewellery ranges skipping brooches for holiday 2026.

signals.summary: Brooches a standout of Copenhagen SS27 street style.
Boomer and Millennial men driving a brooch revival — lapels, sleeves, ties.

trends.name: Archive & vintage hunting
trends.definition: Buying specific past designer eras and vintage pieces as the status item.
trends.reasoning: This is the best-evidenced trend in the edition across time distances. The RealReal measures vintage demand up 432% since 2020, with saved searches for 'Phoebe Philo Celine' up 650%. ThredUp sees Gen Z switching to deliberate 'holy grail' hunting, BoF × McKinsey forecast resale growing two to three times faster than new clothing through 2027, and WGSN's 2028 'Keepers' measure status by provenance and longevity.
trends.wouldChange: Resale growth slowing to firsthand levels in the 2027 reports.

signals.summary: AW27-28 'Matter of Time': longevity as value; materials that look as though they will age well.
Vintage demand up 432% since 2020; decade-specific saved searches +135% YoY; 'Phoebe Philo Celine' searches +650%.
Gen Z shifting from hauls to deliberate 'holy grail' hunting for specific brands and pieces; 58% prioritise secondhand.
WGSN Future Consumer 2028 'Keepers' seek status through provenance, longevity, repair history and material integrity.
'Resale Sprint': secondhand forecast to grow two to three times faster than firsthand through 2027.

trends.name: Poetcore
trends.definition: Modern academia: oversized knits, vintage blazers, corduroy, messenger bags.
trends.reasoning: Pinterest Predicts coined poetcore for 2026 from rising searches for 'the poet aesthetic' and 'dark academia'. Style Arcade then saw men's runways move from streetwear to modern academia at Dior, Ralph Lauren and Zegna. A search-led call confirmed by the runway is a good pattern.
trends.wouldChange: Pinterest's 2027 report dropping it, or streetwear regaining the Lyst brand ranking.

signals.summary: FW26 menswear shifted from streetwear to modern academia, led by Dior, Ralph Lauren and Zegna.
'Poetcore' predicted for 2026 on rising searches for the poet aesthetic and dark academia.

trends.name: Heritage plaid
trends.definition: Checks, tartans and Prince of Wales — heritage patterns in menswear and beyond.
trends.reasoning: Heuritech forecasts plaid up 16% for men in Q4 2026, and Style Arcade's FW26 menswear report found checks and Prince of Wales wool everywhere at Ralph Lauren, Dior and Zegna. It's seasonal and steady, not explosive.
trends.wouldChange: Weak plaid sell-through in the Q4 trading updates.

signals.summary: Checked shirts, plaid jackets, Prince of Wales wool suits abundant across FW26 menswear at Ralph Lauren, Dior, Zegna.
Plaid forecast +16% for men in Q4 2026, +10% for women over 12 months.

trends.name: Statement jewellery
trends.definition: Chandelier earrings, cocktail rings, coloured stones — anything but minimal.
trends.reasoning: BoF × McKinsey list 'Jewellery Sparkles' among the ten themes of 2026 as the category holds up better than clothing, and Marie Claire describes 2026 jewellery as 'everything but minimal', with chandelier earrings in front.
trends.wouldChange: Jewellery sales slowing in the luxury groups' Q3 results.

signals.summary: 2026's defining jewellery trends are 'everything but minimal'.
'Jewellery Sparkles' one of ten themes defining 2026.

trends.name: Saturated blue
trends.definition: Cobalt, royal and 'luminous' blues as the lead colour of 2027.
trends.reasoning: Forecasters and runways line up here. WGSN × Coloro named Luminous Blue the 2027 Colour of the Year, Pantone's NYFW SS27 report includes a deep regal blue, and in Copenhagen's SS27 data blue and pink together made up a fifth of the palette. Menswear treated blue as a foundation colour, not an accent.
trends.wouldChange: Neutrals regaining share in the Paris SS27 colour data.

signals.summary: NYFW SS27 palette includes a deep, saturated regal blue.
Copenhagen SS27 data: blue and pink alone made up 20% of the palette; Marimekko built its collection around blue.
Blue among the foundational — not accent — colours of SS27 menswear.
WGSN × Coloro named Luminous Blue Colour of the Year 2027, pitched from occasionwear to active.

trends.name: The skirt comeback
trends.definition: Full, pleated and bubble skirts, mostly midi, become the centre of the outfit.
trends.reasoning: Retailers told WWD that spring 2027 is 'skirt season', with the Prada skirt as the must-have. Prada put nearly every look in a skirt, and Fashionista called a bra plus a skirt the season's uniform. When buyers commit this early, the high street usually follows within one to two seasons.
trends.wouldChange: Trousers and shorts dominating Paris SS27 and the pre-spring retail buys.

signals.summary: Retailers call spring 2027 'skirt season'; a Prada skirt is the must-have, pleated or pencil, printed, bejewelled, leather or nylon.
Prada's SS27 centred on modernised skirts — pleated, crinoline-lined, floral, layered under leather — alongside voluminous bubble skirts.
Declared a bra and a skirt 'the official uniform of spring 2027'.

trends.name: Big dots
trends.definition: Oversized polka dots on dresses and midi skirts.
trends.reasoning: Heuritech's fastest-growing print: it forecasts Big Dots up 147% in Q4 2026 against Q4 2025 in EU womenswear, after +55% in SS26. The numbers are strong but all come from one forecaster, so the band stays wide.
trends.wouldChange: A second source (retail or search) confirming it, or Heuritech revising it down.

signals.summary: Big Dots forecast +147% Q4 2026 vs Q4 2025 in EU womenswear, +24% over the next 12 months — its highest-growth print.

trends.name: Capris & culottes
trends.definition: Cropped trouser lengths — capri, culotte, cropped slim — replace full-length wide legs.
trends.reasoning: Tagwalk counts capris up 113% season on season, and Fashionista singled out culottes as New York's favourite cropped shape, both sleek (Calvin Klein, Fforme) and baggy (Area, Collina Strada). Runway data and editorial agree, but there's no shopper evidence yet.
trends.wouldChange: Search interest for capris staying flat through the spring 2027 retail launch.

signals.summary: Tagwalk runway data: capris +113% versus the previous season.
Culottes emerge as the favourite cropped pant — sleek at Fforme and Calvin Klein, baggy at Area and Collina Strada.

trends.name: Pink, every shade
trends.definition: Bubblegum, powder and neon pink — in menswear as much as womenswear.
trends.reasoning: In Copenhagen's SS27 data, blue and pink made up 20% of the palette, and pink took over the street style. The SS27 men's shows treated pink and lavender as foundation colours, and Pantone's SS27 report includes an optimistic light pink.
trends.wouldChange: Neutrals holding their share in the Paris SS27 data.

signals.summary: A light, optimistic pink in the NYFW SS27 top-10.
Blue and pink made up 20% of Copenhagen SS27's palette; pink of every shade coloured the street style.
Pink and lavender were foundational SS27 menswear colours, not accents.

trends.name: Ruffles & romance
trends.definition: Ruffled silhouettes, tulle and historical romance soften the season.
trends.reasoning: Tagwalk counts ruffled silhouettes up 96% on the runway, and Heuritech's consumer data already shows an 'opulent romance' mood with historical references for this winter. The romance is there, but it's up against the sharper, sexier lingerie story for the same customer.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech's SS27 update not listing ruffles among growing details.

signals.summary: Tagwalk runway data: ruffled silhouettes +96% versus the previous season.
FW26 consumer data shows 'opulent romance inspired by historical references' and appetite for emotional dressing.

trends.name: Teal & turquoise
trends.definition: Blue-greens — WGSN's Transformative Teal through street-style turquoise.
trends.reasoning: WGSN × Coloro picked Transformative Teal for AW26/27, Pantone's SS27 report includes an energising mid blue-green, and turquoise stood out in Copenhagen's SS27 street style. Forecasters called it early, and the street is catching up.
trends.wouldChange: Teal missing from high-street AW26 markdowns (which would mean it didn't sell).

signals.summary: An energising mid blue-green in the NYFW SS27 top-10.
Turquoise one of the standout colours of Copenhagen SS27 street style.
Transformative Teal among WGSN × Coloro's AW26/27 key colours.

trends.name: Yellow, lemon to acid
trends.definition: Yellow moves from accent to whole garment: trenches, windbreakers, denim and suiting.
trends.reasoning: Pale yellow was the most-bought colour in Milan menswear according to WWD's buyers, and Pantone's NYFW SS27 report opens with a pale herbal yellow. Buyers and a colour forecaster agree, but there's no shopper data yet.
trends.wouldChange: Yellow missing from the high-street spring drops in January–February 2027.

signals.summary: Pantone's NYFW SS27 palette opens with Dill, a pale herbal yellow.
Pale yellow was the most popular colour in Milan menswear for spring 2027, with sand tones and sun-faded neutrals.

trends.name: Weightless fringe
trends.definition: Light, swinging fringe and tassels — art-deco rather than western.
trends.reasoning: Fringe showed up in both New York and Milan with the same lighter feel: in New York at Luar, Ulla Johnson and Monse, and in Milan, where WWD's retailers noted 'lots of fringing', including Bottega Veneta's fringed straw bag. Buyers picking it up is how a runway detail turns commercial.
trends.wouldChange: Fringe missing from contemporary-brand spring buys.

signals.summary: Milan retailers note lots of fringing, plus Bottega Veneta's floor-sweeping fringed straw bag.
Fringe across NYFW at Luar, Kim Shui, Ulla Johnson, Heirlome and Monse.

trends.name: Quiet luxury
trends.definition: Logo-less beige minimalism as a wealth signal.
trends.reasoning: Several independent sources say it's ending. FashionUnited's Copenhagen analysis says the aspirational customer who wore beige to signal wealth is walking away, Who What Wear frames 2026 as the shift from quiet luxury to maximalism, and Pinterest's 2026 report is built on the backlash. It will leave behind basics, but not a trend.
trends.wouldChange: Neutral palettes regaining share in the SS27 runway data.

signals.summary: 2026 framed as the shift from quiet luxury into an era of maximalism.
The aspirational customer who wore beige as a performance of wealth is 'walking away, worn out by neutrals'.
2026 predictions built on a turn away from minimalism and capsule wardrobes toward opulent individuality.

trends.name: Sorbet pastels
trends.definition: Butter yellow, pistachio, lavender and mint, especially in menswear.
trends.reasoning: SS27 menswear moved from dopamine brights to sorbet and sun-faded tones (WWD), Style Arcade saw pastels used as foundation colours rather than accents, and Pitti Filati carries lilac and pink into AW27-28 knitwear, which suggests more than a one-season look.
trends.wouldChange: Spring 2027 menswear retail leading with neutrals instead.

signals.summary: Pink, lavender, lemon and blue were foundational SS27 menswear colours, not accents.
Soft mineral tones in AW27-28 yarns: lilac, pink, denim blue and muted yellow.
Spring 2027 menswear moved into sorbet and sun-faded tones: butter yellow, mint, pale pistachio, lavender, dusty pink.

trends.name: Bag charms
trends.definition: Keychains and trinkets clipped to handbags.
trends.reasoning: Who What Wear lists bag charms among the dated bag trends for 2026, as texture and shape take over as the statement. Only one source says it directly, but it fits the wider move from novelty to craft.
trends.wouldChange: Search interest spiking again in Q4 gift season.

signals.summary: Bag charms listed among dated bag trends for 2026 as texture and shape take over.

trends.name: Linen tailoring
trends.definition: Soft linen suits, 1940s double-breasted jackets, open vests over shirts.
trends.reasoning: Two independent reads of SS27 menswear agree: WWD reports Milan suits slimming down and lightening in linen, silk and seersucker, and Style Arcade calls linen 'the men's suit fabric of choice'. The runway and a retail-analytics platform say the same thing.
trends.wouldChange: Menswear retailers' spring 2027 buys leaning on knit and sport instead.

signals.summary: Linen now 'the men's suit fabric of choice'; 1940s double-breasted, soft blazers, open vests over shirts.
Milan menswear: fabrics lighten up and suits slim down; ultra-light, softer tailoring in linen, silk and seersucker.

trends.name: Liquid satin
trends.definition: Fluid, bias-cut satin replaces 2026's stiff taffeta — skirts, slips, pyjama shorts.
trends.reasoning: Who What Wear named liquid satin the fabric to watch for 2027 after seeing it at Ralph Lauren, Sandy Liang, Cult Gaia and DVF. It fits the lingerie-dressing trend, but so far only one source group supports it.
trends.wouldChange: No satin skirts or slips in Zara and Mango spring 2027 new-in.

signals.summary: Liquid satin named the fabric of 2027, replacing stiff taffeta; seen at Ralph Lauren, Sandy Liang, Cult Gaia and DVF.

trends.name: Nature motifs in menswear
trends.definition: Florals, tapestry flowers and heavy patterning on men's pieces.
trends.reasoning: Style Arcade saw nature motifs become 'a main character' in SS27 menswear (Givenchy's flower-tapestry bombers) and heavy patterning replacing minimal lines. For now it's a single source.
trends.wouldChange: A second source confirming it once SS27 menswear lands in stores.

signals.summary: Nature motifs 'a main character' in SS27 menswear — Givenchy flower-tapestry bombers; heavy patterning returns.

trends.name: Climate-adaptive dressing
trends.definition: Clothes built for extreme heat and unstable weather: light, breathable, performance-natural.
trends.reasoning: This is a structural trend backed across every time distance. Paris buyers dealing with 40°C heat prioritised light, adaptable wardrobes for SS27 (WWD), Première Vision's AW27-28 fabrics centre on breathability and PFAS-free weatherproofing, WGSN's macro trends assume unpredictable weather is the new normal, and WWD reports extreme heat is already straining fashion's seasonal calendar. It builds slowly but is unlikely to reverse.
trends.wouldChange: A run of mild summers would slow it; it wouldn't reverse the supply-chain shift.

signals.summary: AW27-28 fabrics: PFAS-free membranes, bio-based fibres and high-performance materials for durability, breathability and waterproofing.
Extreme heat is challenging fashion's seasonal business model and calendar.
'Chic in the heat' becoming 'a valuable wardrobe category and real commercial opportunity'.
Paris buyers in 40°C heat prioritised lighter fabrics, fluid construction and adaptable wardrobes for spring 2027.
'Comfort Zone': 58% of consumers report moderate to extreme daily stress and seek comfort and reassurance.
AW26/27 macro trend: unpredictable weather as the new normal — adaptable, year-round wardrobes.

trends.name: The pencil skirt returns
trends.definition: The narrow, knee-grazing pencil skirt comes back as a tailoring staple.
trends.reasoning: Tagwalk's runway count shows pencil skirts up 335% on the previous season, the biggest jump of any garment it tracks. It's a single data source, and it's working against the looser silhouettes seen elsewhere, so treat it as a strong early signal, not a consensus.
trends.wouldChange: A second, independent source (retail or search data) picking it up. Without one, it stays a runway blip.

signals.summary: Tagwalk runway data: pencil skirts +335% versus the previous season.

trends.name: Low-slung waists
trends.definition: Waistbands drop — bumsters, low-rise trousers, knits tied at the hip.
trends.reasoning: This trend is now backed by measured data, not just the runway: Heuritech shows low-waist jeans up 28% among women in Europe year on year, with double-digit growth forecast for the next 12 months while high-waist declines, and denim buyers report rises dropping. It's the most likely successor to the high-waisted barrel.
trends.wouldChange: Heuritech's low-waist growth stalling in its next update.

signals.summary: Low-waist jeans up 28% among women in Europe (Aug 2026 vs 2025); double-digit growth forecast for the next 12 months while high waist declines.
Denim buyers: rises are lowering as leg shapes slim.

trends.name: Earthy greens
trends.definition: Moss, lichen and deep botanical greens as core colours.
trends.reasoning: The supply chain is leading here, with fashion following. Première Vision's AW27-28 fabric palette and Pitti Filati's AW27-28 yarns both centre on earthy, botanical greens, and Copenhagen's SS27 data already shows green gaining. Fabric and yarn fairs set what's physically available about 18 months out.
trends.wouldChange: The AW27 runways (February–March 2027) ignoring it.

signals.summary: AW27-28 palette of nuanced neutrals, earthy greens and pigmented greys inspired by living systems.
Copenhagen SS27 data: shades of green in the season palette; Stine Goya put 17% of output in green.
Deeper greens among the AW27-28 yarn colours, with botanical references.

trends.name: Terracotta & Radiant Earth
trends.definition: Clay, rust and burnt red-orange as the next warm neutral.
trends.reasoning: This is the clearest long-range colour call in the edition, with support at every lead time. Future Snoops sees SS27 moving to warm vintage hues like copper brown and deep coral, Pitti Filati's AW27-28 yarns lean on clay and red earth, and WGSN × Coloro named Radiant Earth, a clay-like burnt red-orange, Colour of the Year 2028. When yarn spinners and colour forecasters agree two years out, a colour usually reaches mass retail.
trends.wouldChange: Terracotta missing from Première Vision's SS28 palette (February 2027).

signals.summary: Pitti Filati AW27-28 yarn palette: clay, ginger, bark and red earth give a grounded, vegetal feel.
Grounding colours forecast to trend for spring/summer 2028.
WGSN × Coloro named Radiant Earth, a clay-like burnt red-orange, Colour of the Year 2028: 'a new, reliable yet assertive neutral'.
SS27 colour shifts toward warm vintage hues, including a copper brown ('Golden Hour') and deep coral ('Amber Ash').
